item.title: Temporary Traffic lights not working again, 16th September
item.description:
Temporary traffic lights not working again at the Village Way Junction - no workmen in sight again today. Please get this fixed asap as children will be coming out of local schools from 2.30pm - Charter North, Dulwich Hamlet, Dulwich Village Infants, JAGS, Alleyn's. This is a real safety concern and a child could get hurt.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Village Way, Dulwich Village, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: I complained about this rubbish last week; it's still here, 16th September
item.description:
Dear Council, I added a problem last week where the bins are not being collected for the flats above Londis on Earlswood Street. You responded and said that the next round would collect. They came this morning and didn't collect any of the rubbish again, see photo. I don't know what the problem is and why these particular bins aren't collected. They are often overflowing due to non collection and the residents put bags next to them which are torn and the contents strewn across the pavement.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Earlswood Street, Greenwich
Report on FixMyStreet
